roles: map IP addresses to host names locally
open_questions: Acquire exact 4.1c/4.2BSD hosts file snapshots and compare them with contemporary NIC HOSTS.TXT distributions.

supports: hosts file format and BSD history

related_artifacts.notes: Modern systems commonly retain /etc/hosts alongside DNS rather than deleting the static-file mechanism.
NSS can treat local files as one lookup backend.

notes: A surviving local descendant of static host-table practice; its continued existence does not mean global HOSTS.TXT distribution survived.
